Bonus Proficiencies.notes: You gain proficiency with three skills of your choice.

Cutting Words.notes: When a creature you can see within 60 ft makes a damage roll or succeeds on an ability check or attack roll, you can expend a use of Bardic Inspiration as a Reaction to subtract the die roll from their roll.

Magical Discoveries.notes: You learn two spells from Cleric, Druid, or Wizard lists. They are always prepared and can be replaced on level up.

Peerless Skill.notes: When you fail an ability check or attack roll, you can expend Bardic Inspiration to add the die to the roll. If the roll still fails, the die isn’t expended.
